title: Inbox One
description: Mail-style Inbox One: mailbox rail, session list and a reading pane. Uses the Agents window composer: the reading pane's empty state is the new-session composer (environment, workspace, isolation | branch and harness pickers above the input; mode | permissions and model in its toolbar), and an open session uses the session composer with that session's harness, model and permissions. Every picker opens its real options; choices made on the new-session composer carry into the session it starts.
